instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. Inside a karate dojo with yellow walls, red and blue floor mats, and wall-mounted swords, two martial artists spar. On the left, the man in the black uniform with white stripes (R1) stands in a defensive stance, facing right, and uses his left hand to deflect an incoming strike. On the right, the woman in the black uniform with a red belt (R2) faces left, lunging forward to throw a right-handed punch toward him. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the vibrant mats.
elements: R2 lunges forward to throw a right-handed punch toward R1
R1 uses his left hand to deflect R2's incoming strike
R1 has the defensive receiving role while R2 has the attacking punching role
R1 and R2 face each other while sparring
the sparring occurs inside a karate dojo with mats and wall-mounted swords
